newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bovespa sees 3.379 bln real capital inflow in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Bovespa sees 3.379 bln real capital inflow in 1996.

text.p: Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) said it registered net foreign capital inflows of 721.346 million reais in December, bringing the amount of foreign investment in the bolsa in 1996 to 3.379 billion reais.
Foreign buys amounted to 4.059 billion reais last month, against foreign sales of 3.337 billion reais in the period, it added. -- Fatima Cristina, Sao Paulo Newsroom 5511-2485412
